about: Every move the player gets. One row = one ability = one generated Lua struct in generated/sheets.lua (ABILITIES.<id>).

sm2_reference.about: What it recreates from Marvel's Spider-Man 2

requires.about: State the player must be in

mechanic.about: What the code does each frame

in_game.about: pending until seen working in the real game

rows.name: Web Swing
rows.sm2_reference: Hold-to-swing with automatic anchor choice: no aiming, the web finds a building edge above and ahead
rows.requires: airborne (feet more than ground_probe above ground) and not in a vehicle, menu or scene
rows.mechanic: Raycast a fan of directions up and ahead of the camera; attach to the best hit; shorten the web (fast reel) so the arc's bottom keeps swing_floor_clearance above the ground below; integrate gravity + steering; keep the player on a sphere of rope_length around the anchor (pendulum); reel in slowly; teleport the player each frame
rows.ends_when: swing button released (-> momentum_carry), rope hits min length, or ground reached (-> soft_landing)

rows.name: Momentum Release
rows.sm2_reference: Letting go keeps your speed, with an upward fling when released on the up-swing
rows.mechanic: Keep the swing velocity, add release_boost along it if moving upward, then fly ballistically (gravity + air_drag) with collision sweeps until ground or the next swing
rows.ends_when: ground near (-> soft_landing), next swing, zip or wings

rows.name: Web Wings
rows.sm2_reference: Web wings glide: a fast, shallow glide steered by where you look
rows.mechanic: Horizontal velocity eases toward camera heading at glide_speed; sink rate clamped to glide_sink; collision sweeps as in momentum_carry
rows.ends_when: toggle pressed again, swing, zip, or ground near (-> soft_landing)

rows.name: Web Zip
rows.sm2_reference: Point launch: zip to the spot under your crosshair and pop up off it
rows.requires: aiming (aim held) and a surface under the crosshair within zip_range
rows.mechanic: Raycast from camera along view; fly in a straight line at zip_speed to the hit point pulled back along the surface normal; on arrival add zip_pop upward and continue as momentum_carry

rows.name: Soft Landing
rows.sm2_reference: Spider-Man never takes fall damage from traversal
rows.requires: mod is driving the player and ground is within ground_probe below
rows.mechanic: Place the player ground_clearance above the hit and stop driving, so the game's own fall is a few centimetres (no fall damage)
rows.ends_when: immediately (hands control back to the game)
